title: Better Potions
description: Extends the vanilla potion system with longer-duration potions and new potions
body:
# Better Potions
Extends the vanilla potion system with longer-duration potions and new potions.

**This mod requires Fabric API and Fabric Kotlin Language**

## Features
### Infuser
This block entity permit to you to infuse some ingredients with some ores.

**Craft:**

![First Item: Copper Ingot, Second Item: Blaze Rod, Third Item: Copper Ingot, Fourth Item: Blaze Rod, Fifth Item: Nether Bricks, Sixth Item: Blaze Rod, Seventh Item: Copper Ingot, Eighth Item: Blaze Rod, Ninth Item: Copper Ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d46f44e39e137728facf68761c39546ddf29be1.png)

### Infused Redstone
This item adds 10 minutes to most potions.

**Craft:**

![Infuser with Mixed Iron Coal as fuel, Gold Ingot as catalyzer, Redstone as Ingredient](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0249c33b6175c40fa45d8e201a0a2b4287dd79f7.png)


### Longer duration potions
The mod add a lot of longer duration potion for all vanilla possibles potions.

To craft it, you need to use a Infused Redstone.

**Compatible potions:**
- Night Vision
- Invisibility
- Leaping
- Strong Leaping
- Fire Resistance
- Swiftness
- Strong Swiftness
- Slowness
- Strong Slowness
- Water Breathing
- Poison
- Strong Poison
- Regeneration
- Strong Regeneration
- Strength
- Strong Strength 
- Weakness
- Luck
- Slow Falling
- Wind Charging
- Oozing
- Infesting

**Craft (example):**

![Long Night Vision Potion with Infused Redstone in a Brewing Stand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7b0762470c5c985c80bf53aba7e3ea2c365c1bd.png)

### Infused Blaze Powder
This item is an upgraded Blaze Powder : it adds the double of fuel in the Brewing Stand.

**Craft:**

![Infuser with Mixed Iron Coal as fuel, Emerald as catalyzer, Blaze Powder as Ingredient](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a58d26e558b129b06c4705a177044e22241e1b9f.png)

### Iron Mixed Coal
It is an upgraded coal, in addition to be the fuel needed in the Infuser, it is a better fuel for the Furnace.

**Craft:**

![A coal surrounded with iron nuggets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0af2c70e0232b9debfe633c3ed88a5f8c6e03cc.png)

### Iron Mixed Coal Block
Just a block of Iron Mixed Coal. With a fuel value multiplied by 9 compared to Iron Mixed Coal.

**Craft:**

![A coal block surrounded with iron ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02ea78cef2c489b4f5e3a6dbef5b584020027ce3.png)
![9 iron mixed coal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8f012b98cb50b6a4e988e5fc0196caa11708e49.png)

### Potion of Levitation
The mod adds a craft to potion of levitation.

**Craft:**

![Jump Boost potion with a shulker shell in a Brewing Stand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19bfe29abb1a0a4697a58662c584118d528bd1ef.png)
